task.title: Package BFF and feedback and rewire BFF off snapshots/defaults
task.summary_zh: 替 BFF 與 feedback 補 Docker packaging，並把 BFF read path 從 snapshot/default fallback 改成真正的 service clients。
acceptance: BFF no longer depends on snapshot/default fallback as the normal integration path
BFF and feedback are packaged and runnable in the target stack
PANTHEON_BFF_ALLOW_LOCAL_SNAPSHOT_FALLBACK=false is the normal single-VM path and missing backend data surfaces degraded/unavailable instead of seeded defaults
BFF read clients follow SVC-GOVERNANCE-API and SVC-SERVICE-DISPOSITION boundaries for governance/runtime/evidence/consultation/search data
task.next: Owner finalized after Claude review approval. Delivery commit ad7895d records BFF service-backed read surfaces, feedback packaging, compose URL wiring, py_compile, docker compose config, and focused pytest 22 passed.
review_notes_zh: BFF read path 已從 snapshot/default fallback 翻轉為 HTTP service-client 主路徑：read_store.py 的 CanonicalSnapshotAdapter 與 ServiceBackedReadAdapter 都新增 _HTTP_DATASETS 並把 allow_snapshot_fallback 預設成 False；main.py 的 _bool_from_env(default=False) 對齊單 VM 部署語義；missing service 透過 _dataset_surface_status 正確回 unavailable+unverifiable，不再以 seeded default 矇蔽 operator。

Feedback 服務獨立打包：新增 services/control-plane/feedback/Dockerfile（python:3.11-slim、port 8085）、main.py 補上 /__health__ 別名、compose 改用新 Dockerfile、加上 feedback-data 卷和 TRADER_FEEDBACK_STORE_PATH，舊的 DATABASE_URL/MinIO/NATS 依賴清掉，符合此服務實際 JSONL store 邊界。

BFF compose 環境改為 service-URL 驅動：移除 governance/runtime/incidents 的 :ro 卷掛載與對應 DATA_DIR env，改注入 PANTHEON_DEPLOYMENT_API_URL/PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_APPROVAL_API_URL/PANTHEON_CAPITAL_API_URL/PANTHEON_EVOLUTION_API_URL/PANTHEON_INCIDENTS_API_URL/PANTHEON_POSTMORTEMS_API_URL/PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_API_URL/PANTHEON_LINEAGE_READ_URL 並新增 lineage-read 健康依賴；.env.example 同步補齊。

9 個 HTTP 端點皆已與真實 service routes 對齊（deployment/service.py:928、governance/main.py:225、capital/main.py:417,491、runtime-manager/main.py:221、incidents/main.py:236、postmortems/main.py:280、evolution/main.py:276、lineage-read/main.py:240），runtime-bindings 是唯一需要 Bearer 的 route，read client 也正確帶 PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MANAGER_TOKEN；lineage_edges 額外做 source_id/target_id 與 from/to_artifact_id 欄位轉換以保留 surface 契約。
新測試 test_read_store_service_clients.py 直接驗證 service-client 路徑（含 dataset_source==service_client）、改寫的 test_read_store_bootstrap_snapshot.py 同時驗證 fallback 關閉/開啟兩種行為。
本地 pytest 因環境缺少 pytest 模組無法重跑，已依賴 Codex 報告的 BFF 274 passed、feedback 18 passed；本機驗證 py_compile（exit 0）與 docker compose config --quiet（exit 0）通過。
不在本 packet 範圍：runtime-manager 安全強化由 SVC-RUNTIME-HARDENING 處理；compose stack 啟動/smoke 為 SVC-COMPOSE；consultation/source-ingest/search 啟用為各自的 SVC-* follow-up 任務。

delivery.commit_subject: SVC-SURFACES rewire BFF read surfaces to services

handoffs.message: Implemented HTTP-backed BFF read clients for governance/deployment/capital/runtime/evidence surfaces, disabled local snapshot fallback as the normal BFF path, packaged control-plane feedback with Docker health wiring, and rewired compose/env to service URLs. Verification: BFF pytest 274 passed, feedback pytest 18 passed, py_compile passed with external pycache, docker compose config --quiet passed, git diff --check passed.

Review approved: BFF read path now uses HTTP service clients with snapshot fallback off by default; feedback is independently packaged; service-family URL wiring matches SVC-GOVERNANCE-API/SVC-SERVICE-DISPOSITION boundaries.
